name: YouTube
description: SmartTube 1:1 Parity YouTube Integration for Jellyfin: Multi-User TV OAuth Login, Personal Home/Subscriptions/History/WatchLater Feeds, 4K Ad-Free Direct Streaming, SponsorBlock Auto-Skip, ReturnYouTubeDislike, Favorite-to-Like Sync, and Metadata & Artwork Providers.
overview: 1:1 SmartTube Android TV replacement for Jellyfin with per-user YouTube OAuth, SponsorBlock, ReturnYouTubeDislike, and 4K ad-free playback.

versions.changelog:
- SmartTube 1:1 Parity YouTube Channel (Home, Subscriptions, Continue Watching, Subscribed Channels A-Z, Watch Later, Liked Videos, Playlists, Trending, Gaming, Music, Live)
- Multi-User YouTube TV OAuth Device Code Login (with Public/Anonymous fallback for unlinked users)
- 4K Ad-Free Direct Streaming with SOCKS5 proxy & HLS M3U8 segment rewriting
- Server-side & Web UI SponsorBlock Auto-Skip across Android TV, Fire TV, Web, and Mobile
- ReturnYouTubeDislike community ratings & overview stats
- Native Series/Season/Episode/Movie/Image Metadata Providers, .strm subscription sync, and YouTube Watch History sync
